memory_candidates.content: When de-duplicating re-derived lemmas in a Lean subsystem, publication ORDER can dissolve an apparent signature-mismatch hazard rather than requiring per-site proof work. A weaker duplicate whose sole call site sits inside a sibling duplicate's own proof becomes dead code the moment that sibling is published from a shared module. Sequence publications so the highest-leverage byte-identical fact goes first, then re-check call-site counts before attempting any substitution against a stronger-but-incompatible original. Encode this as a plan phase dependency, not an advisory note: done in the other order it forces callers to manufacture hypotheses they never needed.
